snippet.title: Galerians trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the game Galerians taken from OPM demo disc no.61.

Well the title makes it sound like an arcade shooter from the eighties but apparantly it's not so I had a look while going through my old demo discs, looks interesting so I've ordered a copy. God bless the internet.
